name: second-take
description: Diagnose where an AI answer's reasoning went wrong, then produce a self-contained retake note you paste back so the original AI answers better.

interface.shortDescription: Review weak AI reasoning and hand back a retake note
interface.longDescription: When an AI answer disappoints, Second Take diagnoses the reasoning behind it — six check items, thirteen defect subclasses, four evaluation standards — and produces a retake note: a self-contained instruction packet you paste back into the original conversation so that AI answers better. It never rewrites the answer for you.
